name: Flash Freeze Lake · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 7-block radius for 4.5 s (water and ground beneath turn to ice). Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 16.5 s
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 16.5 s and leaves a puddle
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
